{{nihongo|'''Masanao Aoki'''|青木 正直|Aoki Masanao|May 14, 1931 – July 24, 2018}} was a Japanese [[engineer]] and [[economist]]. He was a Professor [[emeritus]] of Economics at [[University of California, Los Angeles]].

He earned a BA and MSc in physics from the [[University of Tokyo]], and a PhD in engineering from UCLA in 1960.<ref>{{cite journal |first1=Yuji |last1=Aruka |first2=Mauro |last2=Gallegati |first3=Hiroshi |last3=Yoshikawa |title=Special Issue in Honor of Masanao Aoki |journal=Journal of Economic Interaction and Coordination |year=2015 |volume=10 |issue=1 |pages=1–4 |doi=10.1007/s11403-015-0153-9 |s2cid=53701104 |doi-access=free }}</ref> He was a professor of engineering at UCLA and California–Berkeley from 1960 to 1974, before switching fields to economics in which he remained a professor until his retirement in 2002. Aoki's change of research areas is reflected in the two editions of his influential textbook, ''Optimization of Stochastic Systems.'' Originally published in 1967 it contained a rigorous treatment of [[optimal control]] methods in engineering,<ref>{{cite journal |first=R. E. |last=Mortensen |title=''Optimization of Stochastic Systems'' (Masanao Aoki) |journal=SIAM Rev. |year=1971 |volume=13 |issue=4 |pages=579–581 |doi=10.1137/1013111 }}</ref> whereas the second edition (published in 1989) was amended by numerous applications in economics. He died on July 24, 2018, aged 87.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXMZO33611360R30C18A7CZ8000/ |title=青木正直氏が死去 米カリフォルニア大ロサンゼルス校名誉教授 |website=日本経済新聞 電子版 |date=31 July 2018 |language=ja-JP |access-date=2018-08-02}}</ref>

* {{cite book |last1= Aoki |first1= Masanao |year= 1971 |title= Introduction to Optimization Techniques: Fundamentals and Applications of Nonlinear Programming |series= Macmillan series in applied computer sciences |location= New York |publisher= [[Macmillan Publishers|Macmillan]] |isbn= 9780020303657 }}
* {{cite book |last1= Aoki |first1= Masanao |year= 1976 |title= Optimal control and system theory in dynamic economic analysis |series= Dynamic economics |volume= 1 |location= New York |publisher= [[North-Holland Publishing Company|North Holland Pub. Co.]] |isbn= 9780720486032 }}
* {{cite book |last1= Aoki |first1= Masanao |year= 1981 |title= Dynamic analysis of open economies |location= New York |publisher= Academic Press |isbn= 9780120589401 }}
* {{cite book |last1= Aoki |first1= Masanao |year= 1987 |title= State space modeling of time series |location= [[Berlin]]; New York |publisher= [[Springer-Verlag]] |isbn= 9783540172567 }}
* {{cite book |last1= Aoki |first1= Masanao |year= 1996 |title= New Approaches to Macroeconomic Modeling: Evolutionary Stochastic Dynamics, Multiple Equilibria, and Externalities as Field Effects |location= [[Cambridge]]; New York |publisher= [[Cambridge University Press]] |isbn= 9780521482073 }}
* {{cite book |last1= Aoki |first1= Masanao |year= 2002 |title= Modeling aggregate behavior and fluctuations in economics: stochastic views of interacting agents |location= New York |publisher= Cambridge University Press |isbn= 9780521781268 }}
* {{cite book |last1= Aoki |first1= Masanao |last2= Yoshikawa |first2= Hiroshi |author-link2= Hiroshi Yoshikawa |year= 2007 |title= Reconstructing macroeconomics: a perspective from statistical physics and combinatorial stochastic processes |series= Japan-U.S. Center Sanwa monographs on international financial markets |location= Cambridge; New York |publisher= Cambridge University Press |isbn= 9780521831062 }}
